description: Change a live mailbox after confirmation: set_password, add_forwarder, remove_forwarder, add_alias / remove_alias (another address on the same domain delivering into this mailbox; free the address first, e.g. delete its old mailbox), set_autoresponder, delete_autoresponder, set_spam_thresholds, or delete_mailbox. Returns a proposal + confirmToken; call oma_confirm_tool next.

action.description: What to do; the tool description lists each action.

alias.description: add_alias / remove_alias: full address on the same domain.

enabled.description: true turns it on, false off.

endDate.description: set_autoresponder. Strongly recommended: open-ended autoresponders cause backscatter.

name: oma_manage_mailbox
title: Manage mailbox
